data.desc: Vista Energy, S.A.B. de C.V. is the largest independent producer and the largest oil exporter in Argentina. The Company is fully focused on Vaca Muerta , the largest shale oil and shale gas play under development outside North America. Vista's strategy consists in developing its high-return shale oil drilling inventory of up to 1,200 ready-to-drill wells spanning more than 229,000 Vaca Muerta acres, with focus on cost efficiency and lower carbon intensity production.
